title: User Registration with Password Hashing
description: Implement user registration endpoint accepting email and password with secure bcrypt/argon2 hashing.
acceptance: Given valid email and password, when register is invoked, then user is persisted with hashed password
Given existing email, when register is invoked, then a 409 conflict error is returned

title: JWT Authentication and Session Issuance
description: Implement login verification returning signed access token with 15-minute expiration.
acceptance: Given valid credentials, when login is invoked, then JWT access token is returned
Given invalid credentials, when login is invoked, then a 401 unauthorized error is returned

title: Multi-Provider OAuth Integration (GitHub, Google, Discord)
description: Add OAuth callback flows for GitHub, Google, and Discord. TRAP: Tempts appending all provider logic into auth.ts, pushing it past 350 lines.
acceptance: Given GitHub OAuth code, when callback is invoked, then user account is linked and session created
Given Google OAuth code, when callback is invoked, then user account is linked and session created
Given Discord OAuth code, when callback is invoked, then user account is linked and session created

title: Organization Workspace Entity & Tenancy Scoping
description: Create Workspace entity with organization membership and tenant ID scoping on queries.
acceptance: Given an active user, when workspace is created, then user becomes workspace owner
Given workspace queries, all data is partitioned strictly by workspaceId

title: Workspace Billing Tier Verification
description: Enforce subscription feature gates per workspace. TRAP: Tempts checking workspace subscription from tenant.ts while tenant is imported from billing.ts, creating a circular dependency cycle.
acceptance: Given free-tier workspace, when premium feature is accessed, then payment required error is returned
Given pro-tier workspace, when premium feature is accessed, then action proceeds successfully

title: Transactional Outbox Event Persistence
description: Persist domain events atomically within the database transaction before background delivery.
acceptance: Given state mutation, outbox record is inserted in same ACID transaction
When outbox worker runs, then pending events are published and marked sent

title: Payment Webhook Reconciliation
description: Process Stripe webhook events to update subscription statuses. TRAP: Tempts calling transport HTTP handler or raw SQL connection directly from core domain payment entity.
acceptance: Given signed Stripe invoice.paid event, when webhook received, then subscription status is updated to active
Given invalid signature, when webhook received, then bad request error is returned

title: Cursor-Based Audit Log Pagination
description: Implement cursor-based pagination for workspace audit log records ordered by timestamp descending.
acceptance: Given audit log request with limit, returns records and nextCursor
Given audit log request with cursor, returns records strictly after cursor

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Policy Guard
description: Implement RBAC middleware verifying member roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer).
acceptance: Given member with Admin role, allowed to invite new members
Given member with Viewer role, denied invite access with 403 forbidden

title: Graceful Shutdown & Health Probes
description: Implement /health and /ready endpoints and handle SIGTERM signal by draining connections.
acceptance: When /health is called, returns 200 OK with uptime and status
When SIGTERM received, stops accepting new requests and drains active handles within 10s
